newsitem.title: JAPAN: JR East up as JR West payment date nears.
newsitem.headline: JR East up as JR West payment date nears.

text.p: East Japan Railway Co (JR East) shares were higher in mid-morning Tuesday trade, buoyed by hopes for that sector ahead of the listing of West Japan Railways in October, brokers said.
At 0145 GMT, East Japan Railway's shares were up 6,000 yen at 560,000 yen in volume of 3,881 shares.
"The September 27 payment date of the JR West shares is drawing near and expectations for the railways sector are rising," a second-tier broker said.
But some sources said there was still anxiety that if JR East shares were soft, JR West might not make a strong debut and its shares might spiral lower initially.
